t: When you are trying to become someone else
a: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
p: Qad aflaḥa man tazakkā, wa dhakara-sma rabbihi fa-ṣallā.
m: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
